title: Commission Implementing Decision on harmonised packaging and packaging waste labels under Regulation (EU) 2025/40

triage.reason: The Commission has launched an active initiative for a Commission Implementing Decision on harmonised packaging labels under PPWR, with feedback opened on 14 September 2026, a concrete implementing-act development.

draft.summary: A Commission Implementing Decision on harmonised packaging and packaging waste labels under Regulation (EU) 2025/40 is planned as a Commission implementing decision (reference Ares(2026)8548456).
